text.tspan: Computation used to train notable AI systems, by affiliation of researchers
Computation is measured in petaFLOP, which is 10¹⁵ floating-point operations1 .
Note: A research collective is a group of AI researchers who are not organized under an academic or industry affiliation; e.g. EleutherAI.
Computation is estimated by the authors based on published results in the AI literature and comes with some uncertainty. The authors expect the
estimates to be correct within a factor of 2.
